description: Defines the Drupal NodeType configuration entity class, including its properties, methods, and annotations for managing content types within Drupal.

classes.name: NodeType
classes.description: Represents a configurable content type entity in Drupal, with properties and methods for managing content type settings.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the machine name (ID) of the node type.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks if the node type is locked based on Drupal state.

methods.name: setNewRevision
methods.description: Sets whether new revisions should be automatically created for this node type.

methods.name: displaySubmitted
methods.description: Returns whether submission info is displayed.

methods.name: setDisplaySubmitted
methods.description: Sets whether to display submission information.

methods.name: getPreviewMode
methods.description: Gets the preview mode, optionally as an integer.

methods.name: setPreviewMode
methods.description: Sets the preview mode, accepting either a NodePreviewMode enum or an integer.

methods.name: getHelp
methods.description: Returns help information for the node type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the node type.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Performs actions after saving, such as clearing cached field definitions.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Performs actions after deleting node types, such as resetting cache.

methods.name: shouldCreateNewRevision
methods.description: Indicates if new revisions should be created by default.
